close_reason: Added tests/quota_smoke_tests.rs with 4 smoke tests covering both Quota methods: quota_get (ids:null wire form per RFC 9425 §4.2 + USING_QUOTA capability assertion for the entire Quota/* family + populated Quota decode covering all required fields and the warn_limit/soft_limit/description optionals + QuotaScope::Other(String) round-trip for unknown wire strings), quota_changes (passthrough + empty since_state guard). All 4 pass; clippy -D warnings clean. Note: as a bonus this file also pins the third workspace test pattern from JMAP-26di.16 (BodyType/ChatMemberRole/QuotaScope wire enums lack round-trip preservation tests) for the QuotaScope::Other variant specifically; bd:JMAP-26di.16 still tracks the full sweep.
description: Create tests/quota_smoke_tests.rs covering: quota_get (sends ids:null per RFC 9425, USING_QUOTA capability set asserted exactly), quota_changes (passthrough + empty since_state guard, USING_QUOTA).
